goal: Validate every condition before changing state
prompt: In my Roblox game: write a ModuleScript `ShopCore` with a server-side `PRICES` table (itemId to coins) and `ShopCore.refund(state, userId: number, itemId: string): (boolean, string?)`. state.owned[userId] is a set of item ids and state.coins[userId] a number. Refund only when the player owns the item, the item has a price and the player has a coins entry: check all three first and return false and a reason without changing anything when one fails. Only then remove the item and add its price to the coins, and return true.
hard_fail: Changes state before the last check

require.why: a refusal path comes before the coins are changed

forbid.why: state is changed before a later refusal

goal: Session-lock expiry must outlast autosave with a margin
prompt: In my Roblox game: write a ModuleScript `LockRules` with `LockRules.AUTOSAVE_SECONDS = 60`, `LockRules.expiryFor(now: number): number` returning now + 2 * AUTOSAVE_SECONDS + 30, and `LockRules.canAcquire(lock: {owner: string, expires: number}?, jobId: string, now: number): boolean` that is true when there is no lock, the lock is expired (expires <= now) or the lock already belongs to jobId.
hard_fail: Locks expire before the next autosave

forbid.why: a lock that expires exactly now is free (<=)

goal: Snapshot the player list before yielding
prompt: In my Roblox game: write a server Script that autosaves every 60 seconds: `local sessions = {}` maps players to data tables. Each round, first copy the players to save into a separate list, then save each one with DataStore:UpdateAsync inside pcall, warning on failure. Players may leave while saves yield, so the loop must not iterate the live sessions table across a yield.
hard_fail: Iterates the live table across yields

goal: A repeated purchase request is processed once
prompt: In my Roblox game: write a ModuleScript `PurchaseCore` with `PurchaseCore.buy(state, userId: number, requestId: string, price: number): (boolean, string)`. state.done is a set of processed request ids and state.coins[userId] a number. A requestId that was already processed returns true, "duplicate" without charging again; otherwise refuse when the coins are too few, else subtract the price, remember the requestId and return true, "ok".
